text:
[issue by Todst]
### Bug Description

This may be a Sinytra Connector issue but if I disable the ModernFix mod I'm able to enter the End without any issue. It only crashes If I have ModernFix enabled while entering or inside the dimension. 

### Reproduction Steps

1. Install Sinytra Connector(Forgified Fabric API), Enderscape(YetAnotherConfigLib) and ModernFix(Ferritecore) alongside with its dependencies.

2. Start the game and create a new world.

3. Enter the End and the game will crash.

### Log File
